# Virchow Node

**Authors:** Blessing O. Aghedo, Anup Kasi

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

Virchow node, a left supraclavicular lymph node, was first described in 1848 by German pathologist Rudolf Ludwig Karl Virchow (1821-1901) as an indicator of metastatic malignancy, primarily from gastric cancer. The term Troisier sign, named after Charles-Emile Trosier, refers to an enlarged palpable hard left supraclavicular node and is sometimes used interchangeably with Virchow node.
